def st(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    pr=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(rs)<40: pr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2
    tip=16
    if pr: 
        cols=[c for c in range(17,47) if a[pr][c] in 'wg' or a[pr+1][c] in 'wg']
        if cols: tip=max(cols)
    red=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(cs)<50: red=min(cs)
    return tip,red
for i in range(5):
    action(['RIGHT'])
    print(f"R{i+1}:", st(current_frame), {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','reward','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
